question: Does the independently trained real-Zebrahub checkpoint actually encode a fork signal on its time-disjoint external validation set, or did the global accuracy*recall selector hide division failure?

official_supervision_audit.implication: A reciprocal official-only division-weight experiment is underidentified, especially for 44b6-to-6bba.

diagnostic: Teacher-forced GT-node edge probabilities on all 64 frozen external validation shards at thresholds [0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02]; report edge recall plus division-parent recall and precision.
decision_gate: If division-parent recall is zero through 0.02, correct the loss/selection and retrain externally. If recall is positive with useful precision, next isolate transfer while preserving the scratch detector; do not repeat full-model transfer unchanged.
resource: One short RTX6000 job via the common queue; no training and no Kaggle action.
